description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar, sacrificing Su-Chi to add {C}{C}.
Su-Chi and Colfenor trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Colfenor trigger, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever.
Activate Ashnod's Altar, sacrificing Myr Retriever to add {C}{C}.
Myr Retriever triggers, returning Su-Chi from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Su-Chi.
Repeat.
